# FNB-ETAF web UI and locator guidance

- Store logical UI locators in src/test/resources/elements YAML files. Prefer stable data attributes, IDs, and accessibility-aware selectors over fragile positional XPath.
- Preserve existing frame, nested-frame, popup, new-page, viewport, maximize, headless, video, and screenshot behavior.
- Do not use arbitrary sleeps when an existing wait action or configured timeout is appropriate.
- Do not change Hooks or BrowserFactory to resolve a single locator or assertion issue.
- UI action errors must identify the action, logical element, YAML key, page/frame context, and original failure cause. Redact values for password-, token-, secret-, credential-, or authorization-like fields.
- Ensure screenshots, videos, downloads, and feature-name artifact directories retain their existing lifecycle and naming behavior.
